# Live video preset

The live video preset — a player, feature bundle, skins, and media for live video streams

`@videojs/react/live-video` is the preset for live video streams. It bundles `LiveVideoPlayer`, the `liveVideoFeatures` bundle it is configured with, four skins that swap the time slider and time displays for a Live button, and the `Video` media component. See [Presets](../../guides/presets.md) for how presets fit together and [Live streams](../../guides/live-streams.md) for playing a live source.

## Import

```tsx
import { LiveVideoPlayer, LiveVideoSkin, Video } from '@videojs/react/live-video';
import '@videojs/react/live-video/skin.css';
```

Each skin has its own stylesheet. Import `@videojs/react/live-video/neutral-skin.css`, `compat-skin.css`, or `scaffold-skin.css` instead when you use `NeutralLiveVideoSkin`, `CompatLiveVideoSkin`, or `ScaffoldLiveVideoSkin`.

## Usage

Live streams are usually HLS, so this example plays through an HLS media component instead of the preset’s native video.

**App.tsx**

```tsx
import { HlsJsVideo } from '@videojs/react/media/hlsjs-video';
import { LiveVideoPlayer, LiveVideoSkin } from '@videojs/react/live-video';
import '@videojs/react/live-video/skin.css';

export function App() {
  return (
    <LiveVideoPlayer>
      <LiveVideoSkin>
        <HlsJsVideo src="https://example.com/live.m3u8" />
      </LiveVideoSkin>
    </LiveVideoPlayer>
  );
}
```

## Player

`LiveVideoPlayer` is a [`Player`](../components/player.md) created by [`createPlayer`](./create-player.md) with `liveVideoFeatures`. It provides the player store to its descendants and renders no DOM element of its own.

`LiveVideoPlayerProps` types its props:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Content placed inside the player context: a skin, the media, and your own components. |
| `title` | `string \| null` | The title to display. Takes precedence over the title the media reports; `null` clears your value, so the title falls back to the one the media reports. |
| `poster` | `string \| null` | The poster to display. Takes precedence over the poster the media reports; `null` clears your value, so the poster falls back to the one the media reports. |

`title` and `poster` come from the [metadata feature](./feature-metadata.md#player-inputs).

The preset also exports a `usePlayer` hook typed to `liveVideoFeatures`. Use it from any component inside `LiveVideoPlayer`; see [`usePlayer`](./use-player.md).

## Feature bundle

`liveVideoFeatures` is the array of [features](../../guides/features.md) the player is configured with. It is the [video preset’s](./preset-video.md#feature-bundle) `videoFeatures` without playback rate, quality, and audio-track selection, plus the [live feature](./feature-live.md):

| Feature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`playbackFeature`](./feature-playback.md) | Play/pause state and actions for the player store |
| [`volumeFeature`](./feature-volume.md) | Volume level and mute state for the player store |
| [`timeFeature`](./feature-time.md) | Playback position and duration state for the player store |
| [`sourceFeature`](./feature-source.md) | Media source state and actions for the player store |
| [`bufferFeature`](./feature-buffer.md) | Buffered and seekable time range state for the player store |
| [`fullscreenFeature`](./feature-fullscreen.md) | Fullscreen state and actions for the player store |
| [`pipFeature`](./feature-pip.md) | Picture-in-picture state and actions for the player store |
| [`remotePlaybackFeature`](./feature-remote-playback.md) | Remote playback state and actions for the player store |
| [`controlsFeature`](./feature-controls.md) | User activity and controls visibility state for the player store |
| [`textTrackFeature`](./feature-text-tracks.md) | Subtitles, captions, and chapter track state for the player store |
| [`errorFeature`](./feature-error.md) | Media error state and actions for the player store |
| [`liveFeature`](./feature-live.md) | Live edge state for the player store |
| [`metadataFeature`](./feature-metadata.md) | Resolved title and poster values for the player store |

Its type, `LiveVideoFeatures`, is the tuple of those features in order. Import it from the package root:

```tsx
import type { LiveVideoFeatures } from '@videojs/react';
```

To add or remove a feature, pass your own array to `createPlayer`. The skins expect the features they render controls for.

```tsx
import { createPlayer, streamTypeFeature } from '@videojs/react';
import { liveVideoFeatures } from '@videojs/react/live-video';

const { Player, usePlayer } = createPlayer({
  features: [...liveVideoFeatures, streamTypeFeature],
});
```

## Skins

- [LiveVideoSkin](../components/live-video-skin.md) — the default skin, which swaps the time controls for a Live button.
- [NeutralLiveVideoSkin](../components/live-video-neutral-skin.md) — the visually lighter variant, closer to a classic control bar.
- [CompatLiveVideoSkin](../components/live-video-compat-skin.md) — the plain, unbranded variant that avoids newer visual effects, so it looks consistent across browsers.
- [ScaffoldLiveVideoSkin](../components/live-video-scaffold-skin.md) — the minimally styled variant of Compat, a foundation for your own design.

See [Choose a skin](../../guides/skins.md#choose-a-skin) to compare them.

## Media

The preset exports [`Video`](../components/video.md), the same component as the video preset, which renders a native `<video>`. Most browsers need a streaming [media component](../../guides/media-sources.md) to play a live source, such as [`HlsJsVideo`](../components/hlsjs-video.md) for HLS.

## Exports

`@videojs/react/live-video` exports:

| Export | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `LiveVideoPlayer`, `LiveVideoPlayerProps` | The preconfigured [player](#player). |
| `usePlayer` | The player-store hook, typed to `liveVideoFeatures`. |
| `liveVideoFeatures` | The [feature bundle](#feature-bundle). |
| `LiveVideoSkin`, `LiveVideoSkinProps` | The default [skin](#skins). |
| `NeutralLiveVideoSkin`, `NeutralLiveVideoSkinProps` | The neutral [skin](#skins). |
| `CompatLiveVideoSkin`, `CompatLiveVideoSkinProps` | The compat [skin](#skins). |
| `ScaffoldLiveVideoSkin`, `ScaffoldLiveVideoSkinProps` | The scaffold [skin](#skins). |
| `Video`, `VideoProps` | The [media](#media) component. |

Stylesheets: `@videojs/react/live-video/skin.css`, `@videojs/react/live-video/neutral-skin.css`, `@videojs/react/live-video/compat-skin.css`, and `@videojs/react/live-video/scaffold-skin.css`.
